    The comparison functors out of Q₀ #

    Q₀ is the additive envelope of the interval category. The functor ι₀ : Q₀ ⥤ Rep k I realizes its objects as finite direct sums of interval representations, and e₀ : Q₀ ⥤ Q includes it into Q. Both are fully faithful.
